dedupe_keys.name: spw sg secretariat general rail datasets

description: SPW-SG Secrétariat général: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-SG Secrétariat général. Coverage: SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Grands axes ferroviaires en Wallonie dans le cadre de la directive 200; Stations de mesure de la hauteur d'eau des cours d’eau non-navigables ; Stations de mesures qualitatives des eaux souterraines au sens de la D; Stations de mesure de la profondeur d’eau souterraine au sens de la Di. Formats seen: WMS, GEOJSON, GMZ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
